## About
Walnut Park Auto Body is a small, locally owned shop on Watson Rd in St. Louis. The brothers who run it and their crew handle body work on trucks, vans and cars, including full body restorations.
Customers tell us they appreciate hearing from us along the way. On a bigger job, we keep you posted and send photos so you can see how your car is coming along.
We're open Monday through Friday. Give us a call at (314) 965-2953 to set up an estimate. We're rated 4.6 from 47 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Body repair for trucks and cars. One customer said his truck was done on schedule at a competitive price.
- Fixing doors: We've fixed damaged doors, including the back doors on a Ram Promaster van.
- Full body restoration: Full body restoration, including soda blasting the entire car and bumpers.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Give us a call to set up a time. One reviewer called for an estimate and got an appointment the same day.

Q: Do you do full body restorations?
A: Yes. We've done full body restorations, including soda blasting the entire car and bumpers.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.
